[{"proname":"driver_path_folder","args":"p_id text","security_definer":false,"volatility":"i","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.driver_path_folder(p_id text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT regexp_replace(
           regexp_replace(coalesce(p_id, ''), '(%[0-9A-Fa-f]{2})+', '', 'g'),
           '[^A-Za-z0-9_-]', '', 'g')
$function$
"},{"proname":"pod_path_is_driver","args":"p_name text","security_definer":true,"volatility":"s","def":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pod_path_is_driver(p_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT public.current_driver_id() IS NOT NULL
     AND public.driver_path_folder(split_part(coalesce(p_name, ''), '/', 1))
         = public.driver_path_folder(public.current_driver_id());
$function$
"}]
